A plan turn saved PLAN.md silently and /plan said 'Offline plan mode ... Save explicit Markdown with /plan save'. The plan outcome is now notified ('Plan saved to PLAN.md; prior tools restored.') and the /plan message says the next answer is saved.

After autocompact, /cost read 'session unknown; native estimate' because Pi 0.99.2 writes compaction usage without a model. Native compaction and branch-summary usage is now priced on the session model; the reopened session showed 'session estimate $0.2570'.
observations: --autocompact-tokens 20000 first reported Pi's 'Nothing to compact (session too small)': Pi keeps its most recent 20000 tokens (compaction.keepRecentTokens), so a threshold near that has nothing older to summarize. At 42k context tokens it compacted ('Compacted at 42k context tokens.').
